allowed: The seven Task 1.1 dynamic-pooling artifact contracts are implemented and tested.
Their builders and validators produce deterministic fingerprinted fixture artifacts.
Raw global/local score evidence is not represented as calibrated probability.
blocked: Production pool selection, model scoring or downstream handoff execution is complete.
Any dynamic-pooling strategy is empirically superior.
Calibration, statistical support, human review, release or publication is complete.
